stone.where: Main solid rock of the overworld: surface mountains, caves, and underground in all biomes
stone.y_range: 8..320 (solid stone above Y=8; blends to deepslate between Y=8 and Y=0)

deepslate.where: Main solid rock below Y=0; ancient cities
deepslate.y_range: -64..0 (gradient from Y=8 down to Y=0; fully deepslate at Y<=0)

granite.where: Ore blobs in stone in all overworld biomes; also the filler of the copper ore vein

diorite.where: Ore blobs in stone in all overworld biomes

andesite.where: Ore blobs in stone in all overworld biomes; also coral reef crusts

tuff.where: Ore blobs below Y=0 in all overworld biomes; filler of the iron ore vein; sulfur springs

calcite.where: Middle layer of amethyst geodes; striped in stony peaks

smooth_basalt.where: Outer layer of amethyst geodes; also in ancient cities

infested_stone.where: Silverfish ore feature in mountain biomes (meadow, cherry grove, grove, snowy slopes, peaks, windswept hills and forest)

infested_deepslate.where: Deepslate variant of the silverfish ore feature in the same mountain biomes

infested_stone_bricks.where: Strongholds and igloo basements, in place of some stone bricks

infested_cobblestone.where: Rare fake End portal room in woodland mansions

bedrock.where: Indestructible layer at the bottom of the overworld and Nether, the Nether roof, End spikes and End gateways
bedrock.y_range: -64..-60 (overworld floor, gradient to -59); Nether floor 0..4 and roof near 122..127; End spikes and gateways

coal_ore.where: Ore blobs in stone, tuff and deepslate across all overworld biomes

deepslate_coal_ore.where: Coal ore that replaces deepslate or tuff below Y=0

iron_ore.where: Ore blobs in stone across all overworld biomes; main iron source
iron_ore.y_range: -64..319 (three batches; upper batch 80..384 clipped at world top, most common near 232)

deepslate_iron_ore.where: Iron ore in the deepslate layer and in the iron ore vein (tuff filler)

copper_ore.where: Ore blobs across the overworld except dripstone caves (larger blobs there); copper ore vein with granite filler
copper_ore.y_range: -16..112 (trapezoid, most common around Y 47-48); copper vein 0..49

deepslate_copper_ore.where: Copper ore in the deepslate layer below Y=0

gold_ore.where: Ore blobs across the overworld; extra batch in badlands, eroded badlands and wooded badlands
gold_ore.y_range: -64..32 (most common near Y -16); badlands extra batch 32..256

deepslate_gold_ore.where: Gold ore in deepslate and tuff below Y=0

redstone_ore.y_range: -64..15 (plus lower batch -96..-32 clipped to world bottom)

deepslate_redstone_ore.where: Redstone ore in the deepslate layer

lapis_ore.where: Ore blobs across the overworld, plus buried blobs

deepslate_lapis_ore.where: Lapis ore in the deepslate layer

diamond_ore.where: Ore features in stone across the overworld; more common deeper down

deepslate_diamond_ore.where: Diamond ore in the deepslate layer

emerald_ore.where: Single scattered blocks in mountains, windswept hills and windswept forest, meadows, cherry groves, groves, snowy slopes and peaks

deepslate_emerald_ore.where: Emerald ore in the deepslate layer of mountain biomes

raw_iron_block.where: Replaces about 2% of iron ore inside iron ore veins

raw_copper_block.where: Replaces about 2% of copper ore inside copper ore veins

nether_gold_ore.where: Netherrack blobs in all Nether biomes; more attempts in basalt deltas

nether_quartz_ore.where: Netherrack blobs in all Nether biomes; more attempts in basalt deltas

ancient_debris.where: Scattered in netherrack, basalt and blackstone, never exposed to air
ancient_debris.y_range: 8..24 (main clusters, peak near 16); rare small clusters up to about 247

dirt.where: Upper terrain layers in most overworld biomes; dirt blobs inside stone; shallow-water disks

coarse_dirt.where: Patches in windswept savanna, wooded badlands, old growth taiga and dappled forest; ice patches; trail ruins; abandoned camps

rooted_dirt.where: Roots under azalea trees in lush caves
rooted_dirt.y_range: -64..256 (rooted azalea tree placement; extends into lush caves)

podzol.where: Old growth taiga, bamboo jungle, trial chamber spawner areas, abandoned camps

mycelium.where: Mushroom fields in abundance; single blocks in swamp abandoned camps

grass_block.where: Surface of most overworld biomes; disks between mud in mangrove swamps; villages and ancient cities

mud.where: Mangrove swamp terrain; trail ruins; some trial chamber entrance rooms

clay.where: Blobs in lush caves and underwater disks in shallow rivers, lakes and oceans; mason houses in villages
clay.y_range: -64..256 (lush caves blobs, any height); underwater disks at sea level

moss_block.where: Floor and ceiling of lush caves; trial chambers

muddy_mangrove_roots.where: Where mud meets mangrove roots in mangrove swamps; some trial chamber entrances

mangrove_roots.where: Roots of mangrove trees in mangrove swamps; some trial chamber entrances

sand.where: Disks in shallow water; deserts and beaches (layers over sandstone)

red_sand.where: Single layer in badlands below about Y=74

gravel.where: Blobs in stone and disks in shallow water across overworld biomes; beds of deep water

suspicious_sand.where: Buried rooms under desert pyramids, desert wells, warm ocean ruins

suspicious_gravel.where: Cold ocean ruins and trail ruins

sandstone.where: Under sand in deserts and beaches; desert wells, villages, pyramids, warm ocean ruins

red_sandstone.where: Floating badlands cave entrances, replacing red sand

terracotta.where: Badlands layers; desert and plains village houses and lamps

white_terracotta.y_range: above about 74 (badlands layers); also under shallow water

orange_terracotta.y_range: above about 74 (layers); lower elevations below red sand

ice.where: Freeze-top-layer ice on frozen oceans, frozen rivers, snowy beaches, lakes and exposed aquifers in snowy biomes

packed_ice.where: Ice spikes, frozen peaks, ice caves, icebergs, igloo windows, some snowy village houses

blue_ice.where: Bottoms of icebergs and arches in frozen oceans; piles in snowy village houses; ancient cities

snow_block.where: Ground in ice spikes, groves, snowy slopes and peaks; igloo walls; some abandoned camps

powder_snow.where: Strips in groves and snowy slopes; trial chamber rooms

obsidian.where: Ruined portals (Overworld and Nether); woodland mansion obsidian rooms; cold ocean ruins; End spikes on the main End island and End ship (End city)

crying_obsidian.where: Some ruined portals (about 15% of their obsidian)

magma_block.where: Overworld: underwater clusters at aquifer bottoms, sulfur springs, ocean ruins, ruined portals outside cold biomes, trial chamber eruption rooms. Nether: magma ore features on netherrack

budding_amethyst.where: Replaces about 8% of the inner amethyst layer of geodes

sculk.where: Sculk patches in the deep dark biome, plus sculk veins

sculk_catalyst.where: Deep dark biome and ancient cities

sculk_shrieker.where: Ancient cities (sculk patches), rarely in the deep dark biome

bee_nest.where: Bee trees in forests, flower forests and plains

pumpkin.where: Pumpkin patches on clear grass in most overworld biomes; woodland mansions, taiga villages, pillager outposts, abandoned camps

melon.where: Melon patches in jungle biomes; savanna villages; woodland mansion tillage rooms; abandoned camps

hay_block.where: Hay piles in plains villages (less often savanna and desert villages); pillager outposts; abandoned camps

bone_block.where: Fossils in desert, swamp and mangrove swamp biomes; nether fossils; trial chamber spawners
bone_block.y_range: -64..-8 (lower fossils) and 0..319 (upper fossils); nether fossils in soul sand valleys

netherrack.where: Most of the Nether terrain; ruined portals; bastion remnants

soul_sand.where: Soul sand valleys surface; Nether ore blobs; fortress nether wart rooms; ancient cities (Overworld)

soul_soil.where: Soul sand valleys surface, with soul sand

basalt.where: Basalt deltas (terrain, blobs and columns) and soul sand valley pillars

blackstone.where: Basalt deltas, below lava seas, underground blobs, bastion remnants

polished_blackstone_bricks.where: Bastion remnants and Nether ruined portals

cracked_polished_blackstone_bricks.where: Bastion remnants and Nether ruined portals

chiseled_polished_blackstone.where: Bastion remnants and Nether ruined portals

nether_wart_block.where: Huge crimson fungi in crimson forests

warped_wart_block.where: Huge warped fungi in warped forests

shroomlight.where: Upper parts of huge crimson and warped fungi

glowstone.where: Ceilings of netherrack in all Nether biomes (rarer in soul sand valleys); bastion hoglin stables

crimson_stem.where: Trunks of huge crimson fungi in crimson forests

warped_stem.where: Trunks of huge warped fungi in warped forests

nether_bricks.where: Walls and pillars of Nether fortresses

end_stone.where: All End islands, main and outer

oak_log.where: Oak trees across temperate overworld biomes; azalea trees; fallen oak trees

spruce_log.where: Spruce trees in taiga and snowy taiga; mega spruce and pine trees; fallen spruce trees

birch_log.where: Birch trees in birch forests and other forests; fallen birch trees

jungle_log.where: Jungle trees and jungle bushes in jungle biomes; fallen jungle trees

dark_oak_log.where: Dark oak trees in dark forests

pale_oak_log.where: Pale oak trees in pale gardens (creaking hearts inside trunks)

poplar_log.where: Poplar trees in dappled forests (26.3); fallen poplar trees

oak_leaves.where: Canopy of oak trees; also in plains villages, trial chambers, abandoned camps

spruce_leaves.where: Canopy of spruce trees; abandoned camps

birch_leaves.where: Canopy of birch trees; abandoned camps in birch and flower forests

jungle_leaves.where: Canopy of jungle trees; abandoned camps in bamboo jungles

acacia_leaves.where: Canopy of acacia trees in savannas; abandoned camps

dark_oak_leaves.where: Canopy of dark oak trees in dark forests; woodland mansions

mangrove_leaves.where: Canopy of mangrove trees; some trial chamber entrances

cherry_leaves.where: Canopy of cherry trees in cherry groves

pale_oak_leaves.where: Canopy of pale oak trees in pale gardens

creaking_heart.where: About 10% of pale oak trunks in pale gardens (fully enclosed by logs)

brown_mushroom_block.where: Huge brown mushrooms (mushroom fields, taiga, swamp); swamp abandoned camps

red_mushroom_block.where: Huge red mushrooms (mushroom fields, taiga, swamp); swamp abandoned camps

mushroom_stem.where: Trunks of huge brown and red mushrooms; dark forest vegetation

stone_bricks.where: Strongholds (walls, floors, ceilings); ruined portals; cold ocean ruins; igloo basements; trail ruins; trial chambers

mossy_stone_bricks.where: Strongholds and igloo basements; ocean ruins; ruined portals

cracked_stone_bricks.where: Strongholds; ocean ruins, igloo basements, ruined portals, trail ruins

chiseled_stone_bricks.where: Ocean ruins, ruined portals, jungle pyramids (three per pyramid), igloo basements

mossy_cobblestone.where: Monster rooms, jungle pyramids, pillager outposts, cold ocean ruins, plains and taiga villages; forest rocks; trial chambers

cobblestone.where: Monster rooms, jungle pyramids, pillager outposts, ocean ruins, strongholds, villages, woodland mansions, trail ruins

prismarine.where: Ocean monuments (main structure blocks); cold ocean ruins

prismarine_bricks.where: Ocean monuments (main structure blocks and pillars)

sea_lantern.where: Ocean monuments and some ocean ruins

wet_sponge.where: Sponge rooms of ocean monuments (about 30 per room)

bricks.where: Ocean ruins, plains village armorer houses, trail ruins

polished_andesite.where: Igloo basements, woodland mansions, trial chamber supply chests

polished_tuff.where: Trial chambers (primary ceiling block of many rooms)

cut_sandstone.where: Desert villages, desert pyramids, warm ocean ruins

chiseled_sandstone.where: Desert pyramids, warm ocean ruins, trial chambers

sandstone_slab.where: Desert pyramids, desert villages, desert wells

cobblestone_slab.where: Plains villages, pillager outposts, woodland mansions

spawner.where: Monster rooms (dungeons: center spawner plus scattered cave spider spawners); stronghold end portal room (silverfish spawner); woodland mansion secret room (spider spawner)

trial_spawner.where: Every chamber and corridor of trial chambers except entrance and intersection chambers

bookshelf.where: Village libraries and some village houses; stronghold libraries
